reason: The supported ASCII REG_NOSUB boundary is source-reviewed and validated. Repeats for which glibc duplicates a captured subtree consumed by a backreference now stop before matching and are tracked in posix-finite-repeat-backreference-arrival; the audit proved that glibc's compiled-node arrival state cannot be represented by the existing capture-value heuristic without false positives and negatives.

boundary.startingEvent: A valid ASCII POSIX ERE installed by startup MSGTYPE or AUTOPICKUP_EXCEPTION is matched through the recorder-glibc REG_EXTENDED|REG_NOSUB contract.
boundary.endingEvent: Matching selects the same boolean and MSGTYPE action as recorder glibc within the committed direct and reference time/memory budgets at exact 255-byte pattern and message limits.
boundary.validInputs: Direct ASCII EREs, supported reference-aware EREs, star/optional/single-occurrence referenced repetitions, suffix-reaching correlated and zero-minimum reference patterns, and unanchored direct/reference wide-frontier patterns within the source byte limits.
boundary.observables: Match boolean and installed MSGTYPE action, complete fresh screens/cursors and PRNG calls, plus isolated wall time and maxRSS for every declared exact-boundary resource case.
boundary.exclusions: A compile-surviving repeat which makes glibc duplicate a captured subtree used by a compile-surviving backreference stops at UnsupportedPosixDuplicatedCaptureError and is tracked by posix-finite-repeat-backreference-arrival. This includes finite maxima above one, plus, and positive-minimum unbounded intervals; it excludes star, optional, {0}, {1}, {0,1}, and {0,}, and ignores every capture/reference subtree erased by {0}. Non-ASCII C.UTF-8 locale matching, runtime autopickup object filtering, interactive MSGTYPE editing/serialization, USER_SOUNDS, and behavior after the next message/input boundary remain named before-effect boundaries.

candidateListMethod.upstreamEntryPoints: sys/share/posixregex.c regex_match delegates to glibc regexec; glibc capture endpoint selection defines the finite-repeat result; options.c msgtype_type and add_autopickup_exception are the installed consumers.
candidateListMethod.dispatchTablesAndCatalogs: The shared exact-boundary fixture catalog, its complete budget map, 255-byte source limits, repeat endpoint states, referenced capture ids, candidate starts, and absolute suffix constraints define the audited families.
candidateListMethod.reachableHelpers: The audit supplied direct-libc/live MSGTYPE discriminators for the endpoint defect and four suffix-reaching exact-boundary families that separately exercise correlated state, zero-minimum state, direct candidate ordering, and reference candidate reuse.
candidateListMethod.javascriptCrossCheck: Inspect js/posixregex.js repeat endpoint/continuation projections, direct/reference sequence search and suffix feasibility, plus all shared fixture/oracle/resource consumers for masked paths, separate catalogs, aborts, or guessed booleans.
candidateListMethod.remainingLimits: The catalog names literal-suffix guard coverage separately from suffix-reaching direct memo, reference memo, zero-minimum, and correlated-frontier cases. Exact finite-copy OPEN/CLOSE arrival provenance remains the explicit posix-finite-repeat-backreference-arrival deferral rather than a guessed boolean.

entries.candidate: Duplicated-repeat capture and backreference arrival provenance
entries.reachability: A repeat makes glibc duplicate a captured subtree whose value a later backreference consumes, so distinct OPEN/CLOSE occurrences can reach the same input and capture values.
entries.effects: glibc validates distinct compiled OPEN/CLOSE occurrences with check_arrival before a backreference can affect MSGTYPE or AUTOPICKUP_EXCEPTION.
entries.evidence: Systematic recorder-libc comparison found both false positives and false negatives in capture-value endpoint heuristics. regex_compile still accepts the source-valid syntax, while regex_match raises UnsupportedPosixDuplicatedCaptureError before a rule action is selected; runSegment preserves the supported prefix as a named boundary.
entries.remaining: Port the lazy occurrence-aware state log and backreference arrival cache recorded by posix-finite-repeat-backreference-arrival, then restore its libc, live-message, and resource matrices.

entries.reachability: A valid 255-byte suffix-reaching reference pattern materializes large repeat/capture frontiers before downstream references and fixed suffix structure decide viability.
entries.effects: Synchronous matching exceeds the committed 2,000 ms and 128 MiB budget while producing the correct boolean.
entries.evidence: A correlated near-miss reached about 177 MiB, and a zero-minimum valid match reached about 4.4 seconds/943 MiB; recorder libc agreed on both booleans within the budget.
entries.remaining: None; lazy continuation testing and incremental frontier deduplication preserve exact booleans. The zero-minimum valid match measured 152 ms/107 MiB and the correlated near-miss 859 ms/122 MiB under their 2,000 ms/128 MiB budgets.

entries.reachability: A nullable unanchored direct pattern has a rightmost suffix-aligned match after expensive earlier candidate starts.
entries.effects: Left-to-right candidate work exceeds the committed 1,000 ms budget despite REG_NOSUB exposing only a boolean.
entries.evidence: The 255-byte wide-frontier pattern on a 255-byte suffix-reaching input matched like libc but independently measured about 1.2 seconds, over budget.
entries.remaining: None; REG_NOSUB tries the suffix-aligned rightmost candidate first while every evaluator call retains its actual matchStart. The exact case measured 2.5 ms/49 MiB under its 1,000 ms/96 MiB budget.

entries.remaining: None; the catalog names one guard and four suffix-reaching 255-byte cases for direct memo, reference memo, zero-minimum, and correlated-frontier evaluation, each with a libc boolean and isolated budget.

sourceReview: Complete for the stated boundary. Read sys/share/posixregex.c regex_match, glibc 2.39 regcomp.c parse_dup_op and regexec.c get_subexp/check_arrival, options.c msgtype_type/add_autopickup_exception, and the recorder libc oracle contract. The supported corpus has 144 recorder-libc regex comparisons, five vpline comparisons, six isolated resource cases, and 28 fresh MSGTYPE segments. Duplicated capture occurrence provenance is identified by a named before-effect stop and an open quality deferral.
